annotations.title: Find the price needed for a profit goal

description: Find the lowest list price on each US marketplace that reaches a goal: a profit in USD, a profit margin percent, or an ROI percent. Results are sorted from cheapest required price; marketplaces where the goal can't be reached are listed with the reason.

detail.description: summary (default) returns totals and fee lines; full returns the complete REST response.

estimated_sales_tax.description: Sales tax collected from the buyer, in USD (some marketplaces charge fees on it). Default 0.

fulfillment_date.description: amazon_fba only: ship date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the FBA rate card. Defaults to today (UTC). Range 2026-01-15 to 2027-10-14.

item_cost.description: Seller's cost of the item, in USD. Default 0.

marketplaces.description: Limit to these marketplaces. Default: all. amazon_fba and walmart_wfs are skipped unless package is given.

other_costs.description: Other per-item costs (packaging, ads, etc.), in USD. Default 0.

overrides.description: Per-marketplace category, options or shipping values, e.g. {"ebay": {"options": {"store_subscription": "basic"}}, "etsy": {"options": {"offsite_ads_percent": 15}}}. package.description: Packaged unit dimensions (inches) and unit weight (pounds), used to determine the fulfillment size tier, dimensional weight (L x W x H / 139) and shipping weight. Required for amazon_fba and walmart_wfs.

shipping_charged.description: Shipping the buyer pays, in USD. Default 0.

shipping_cost.description: Seller's shipping label cost, in USD. Default 0.

target.description: Exactly one of profit, margin_percent or roi_percent.

margin_percent.description: Profit as a percent of revenue (below 100).

roi_percent.description: Profit as a percent of total costs. Needs item_cost, shipping_cost or other_costs.
